# Offerlane

> Offerlane is a free AI job-application agent. It finds matching job postings, tailors your
> resume per listing, submits the application through the employer's real applicant tracking
> system, and tracks replies — automatically.

## Key facts

- Free. No pricing tiers, no trial, no payment required.
- No account or login required. Resume and preferences are stored locally in the user's browser.
- Core loop: find → tailor → apply → track.
- Submits through real ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, iCIMS, and others),
  not a browser autofill shortcut.
- Two modes: Review (approve each application) and Auto Apply (fully automated, subject to a
  daily fair-use cap).
- Does not fabricate work experience, education, or credentials.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://offerlane.com/): overview, pricing stance, FAQ.
- [App](https://offerlane.com/app): the product itself.
- [Auto Apply](https://offerlane.com/auto-apply): details on automated submission mode.
- [Interview prep](https://offerlane.com/interview-prep): mock interviews, coding practice,
  system design, feedback scoring.
- [MCP server](https://offerlane.com/mcp): programmatic access for agents.
- [FAQ](https://offerlane.com/#faq): common questions, including data storage and visa filters.
